stories.headline: Bread & Fred is now free to keep on the Epic Games Store
stories.summary: The co-op precision platformer is now free to claim on the Epic Games Store until December 3 at 17:00. Two tethered penguins must coordinate jumps, swings and wall grabs to climb a snowy mountain, with a solo mode also available. Claim the game before the offer expires to keep it in your library. [Epic Games Store](https://store.epicgames.com/p/bread-and-fred-1db362).

stories.headline: Appulse launches on PC with a 20% introductory discount
stories.summary: Raw Fury and Le Rado released this top-down action roguelite on November 26. Gun recoil and pinball flippers control movement as players defend their mothership from robots, board enemy ships and assemble builds from randomized upgrades. Steam confirms the game is available with a 20% launch discount through December 10, and a demo remains available.

stories.headline: The Temple offers a free cosmic horror adventure on Steam
stories.summary: Solo developer Klems released this approximately two-hour science-fiction horror game on November 24. Explore an abandoned aquatic colony in a submarine, an airship and an orbital shuttle, managing each vehicle's distinct systems while solving puzzles and uncovering the fate of the colonists. The complete game is free to play.

stories.headline: Ubisoft reportedly asks teams to justify not using generative AI
stories.summary: VGC reports that developers pitching new projects at Ubisoft are being asked to explain how they would use generative AI, or why they would choose not to. The claims are attributed to unnamed sources speaking to Vertical Slice, and do not establish a confirmed company-wide mandate. The report follows Ubisoft's establishment of its Motherbrain AI subsidiary.

stories.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever rebalances Alterac Valley and buffs Balance Druids
stories.summary: Blizzard's November 25 hotfix shifts Alterac Valley rewards away from rushing the opposing general and toward capturing objectives, while strengthening enemy NPCs. Balance Druids gain revised talents and 10% additional Arcane and Nature damage in Moonkin Form. Hunter and Warlock pets can critically strike again, Paladin Exorcism can now crit, and Judgements refresh correctly. Eligible Paladin and Warlock mount quests now grant Journeyman Riding, and Scarlet Subterfuge's disguise lasts an hour instead of 30 minutes.

stories.headline: Warhammer Survivors hotfix makes every enemy drop XP
stories.summary: Auroch Digital released hotfix 2.1.8 on Steam on November 25. A new low-value experience gem ensures every defeated enemy grants XP. Several weapons receive damage or aiming improvements, enemy health is reduced for foes such as Beasts of Nurgle and the Carnifex, and miniboss health bars and shorter chest animations improve readability and pacing. Console and mobile availability is pending.

stories.headline: Rayman Legends Retold reveals its new story and voiced cinematics
stories.summary: Ubisoft's November 25 story deep dive explains how a mysterious figure and corrupted Teensies threaten the Glade of Dreams. The reimagined platformer features four playable heroes, a rebuilt Land of the Livid Dead, fully voiced cinematics and a new narrative. It launches December 3 on PC and consoles, with up to four-player local co-op.

stories.headline: Rockstar workers vote against formal union recognition
stories.summary: According to the IWGB, 75% of participating Rockstar employees voted against a union recognition agreement and 25% supported it. The ballot drew 1,544 voters, with turnout above 93%. The existing union will continue organizing, but Rockstar will not be obliged to engage in regular collective bargaining under the proposed agreement.
